name: AIssistant Shop Manager
author: Camacam LTD

sections.description:
AIssistant Shop Manager helps WooCommerce store owners
manage and optimize their stores using AI.

What AIssistant does for you:

  • Daily shop analysis — sales, trends, customer behaviour
  • Autonomous promotion suggestions and execution
  • Continuous shop development recommendations
  • Full WooCommerce integration — orders, products, customers care

AIssistant works in the background so you can focus on your business, not on managing a tool.

Product Demo

External services

This plugin connects to the Camacam AI service in order to process AI requests and product automation features.

Service endpoint:
https://brains.aissistant.site

Data sent:
– Product titles
– Product descriptions
– Store-related content
– Error logs (when errors occur)

This data is sent only when the plugin functionality is used.

Terms of Service:
https://aissistant.site/terms-and-conditions.html

Privacy Policy:
https://aissistant.site/privacy-policy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin — WooCommerce must be installed and active
  3. Navigate to Aia in the WordPress admin menu
  4. AIA enrolls your store automatically — no manual configuration needed
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

No. AIA is built exclusively for WooCommerce stores.

Do I need an account?

Yes. AIA connects to the aissistant.site platform. An account is created automatically on first activation.

Does it replace my existing setup?

AIA works alongside your existing WooCommerce setup. It adds an autonomous management layer on top without disrupting what you already have.

How does AIA update?

AIA checks for updates automatically and notifies you in the WordPress Plugins page when a new version is available.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Warehouse code cleanup
  • Visits tracker

1.0.3

  • Warehouse integration framework.
  • Visits tracker.

1.0.2

  • The shop language sent on connect is the language the site runs in, also when it is set in wp-config.php or by a filter.

1.0.1

  • First production release.
  • Multisite: every site of a network connects as its own shop. Network activation connects all sites, sites added later are connected automatically, and Network Admin → AIssistant lists every site with a Connect button.

0.1.17

  • Applied product texts also set the focus keyphrase in Yoast or Rank Math, so the SEO plugin can score the new copy.

0.1.16

  • Price tests can be applied from the dashboard and undone. The shop can send an email the way it sends its own order emails. A promo code can be made for one customer.

0.1.15

  • Suggestions can now be applied from the dashboard. Category changes can be undone. Product texts are written to the product and its SEO plugin.

0.1.14

  • Create promo code via Woo API

0.1.13

  • New applypromotion endpoint: puts the products of an AIssistant recommendation on sale (sale price + sale dates through the WooCommerce product API, variable products per variation) and can end such a promotion early. Compare-and-set on the regular price, idempotent, never touches a sale the merchant set.

0.1.12

  • Renamed plugin to AIssistant Shop Manager across the admin menu, page title, and plugin header

0.0.7

  • Improved update detection and inline update notice
  • WooCommerce dependency check on activation
  • Locale fallback to en_US for older WordPress installations
  • Security and compatibility improvements

0.0.6

  • Initial public release
